questions.question: What two objects did God show Jeremiah in chapter 24?
options: Two clay jars, one full and one empty
Two baskets of figs, one good and one bad
Two scrolls, one sealed and one open
Two olive trees, one green and one withered
questions.answer: Two baskets of figs, one good and one bad

questions.question: What did the good figs represent?
options: The kings who would one day return to rebuild the city of David
The exiles God sent to Babylon, whom he would watch over for good
The nations that would one day come to worship the LORD God
The priests who had yet remained faithful in the temple of the LORD
questions.answer: The exiles God sent to Babylon, whom he would watch over for good

questions.question: The bad figs represented Zedekiah and those who remained, whom God would make a horror.
Like these good _____, so I will regard as good the exiles from Judah.
I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD, and they shall be my _____.
